context: Mother and child have a cold-day morning routine
purpose: Teach: 確認する/検診/寒い/笑顔/寝室/朝食/翌朝/起き上がる

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔ちゃん、もう起きる時間よ。カーテン開けるね。
lines.en: Sho, it's time to get up. I'll open the curtains.
lines.style: Gentle wake-up call, warm maternal morning voice, soft caring tone

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うぅ…今日寒いよ。布団から起き上がりたくない…。
lines.en: Ugh... it's cold today. I don't want to get out of the futon...
lines.style: Sleepy reluctant child whining, drowsy and stuffy nasal tone

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: あら、ほっぺ赤いね。ちょっと熱があるか確認するよ。
lines.en: Oh my, your cheeks are red. Let me check if you have a fever.
lines.style: Concerned mother shifting to gentle worry, soft caring delivery overall

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、昨日の夜から喉が痛かったの…。寝室まだちょっと寒い。
lines.en: Mom, my throat has been hurting since last night... The bedroom is still a bit cold.
lines.style: Small weak voice from sick child, slightly tearful undertone throughout

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 37度8分か。今日は学校お休みにして、午後に病院で診てもらおう。来月の定期検診も近いしね。
lines.en: 37.8 degrees. Let's skip school today and have you seen at the clinic this afternoon. Your regular checkup is coming up next month too.
lines.style: Decisive but gentle mom tone, calm reassuring problem-solver voice

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Quiet refusal from unwell child, mumbling and listless delivery

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: じゃあ温かいおかゆだけ作るね。よく寝れば、翌朝には元気になるよ。
lines.en: Then I'll just make some warm rice porridge. If you sleep well, you'll feel better the next morning.
lines.style: Soothing maternal coaxing voice, soft optimistic encouragement throughout the line

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Small grateful murmur from tired child, faint affectionate whisper tone

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ふふ、笑顔出たね。今日はゆっくり休もうね。
lines.en: Hehe, there's that smile. Let's take it easy today.
lines.style: Warm motherly laugh, tender affectionate closing tone overall delivery
